versions.content: SessionControl Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x10 (SessionControl). Rationale: The usage of different diagnostic sessions is very common and therefore needs to be supported by the Diagnostic Extract Template. Use Case: Support the switching from one diagnostic session to another. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
